{{Quote|I've been to Nauton IV, where Master Ruati was ''beheaded'' by an unknown assassin&hellip;|Obi-Wan Kenobi, on Ruati's death|<ref name="Obsession 1">[[Obsession 1|''Obsession'' 1]]</ref>}}
'''Ruati''' was a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia Ruati">{{CSWECite|III|113|Ruati, Master}}</ref> a conflict fought between the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] from [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Ruati was [[Sai cha/Legends|beheaded]] by an [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nauton IV]]<ref name="Complete Encyclopedia Nauton IV">{{CSWECite|II|363|Nauton IV}}</ref> in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].<ref name="Death date" /> Fellow  [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] investigated Ruati's [[Death/Legends|death]] and came to the conclusion that the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]&mdash;whom was believed to be dead at the time&mdash;was responsible for Ruati's murder. Kenobi later mentioned Ruati's death while dueling with [[Xist]], a [[Vigo/Legends|Vigo]] with the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate. Following their defeat in the duel, Xist gave the Jedi a lead on Ventress's possible location.<ref name="Obsession 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ruati was first mentioned in [[Obsession 1|''Obsession'' 1]], the first issue of the ''[[Star Wars: Obsession]]'' [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], written by [[W. Haden Blackman]] and released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Obsession 1" /> on [[November 24]], [[2004]].<ref name="Obsession 1 release">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54459/star_wars_obsession_2004_1|text=Star Wars: Obsession (2004) #1}}</ref>
